name: PaintBall VR
summary:
Step into an immersive virtual reality paintball experience built for action-packed combat and endless fun. Battle against intelligent AI enemies across beautifully designed environments using responsive and satisfying shooting mechanics made specifically for VR.

Choose from multiple exciting game modes including:

Time Mode – survive and score before time runs out
Wave Mode – fight increasing waves of enemies
Survival Mode – test your endurance against nonstop combat
One Life Mode – every decision matters
